cohort: 80,663 babies born to 78,085 women aged 13-49 years who gave birth to a live or stillborn baby weighing >1000 g between July 2021 and December 2022 in 16 hospitals in Benin, Malawi, Tanzania, and Uganda.
finding: The largest contributors to stillbirths were Robson group 10 (preterm birth) and Robson group 3 (multipara with cephalic term singleton in spontaneous labor), each accounting for a quarter of stillbirth mortality.
